title: yellow-crusted, fluffy dutch pecan galette
description: A cozy dutch dish featuring pecan nuts, deglazed with a hint of bourbon and topped with a crispy yellow crust. Perfect for a snacking breakfast or brunch.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, granulated sugar, and salt. Add the softened butter and use a pastry blender or your fingertips to work it into the dry ingredients until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, heavy cream, and bourbon. Add the melted butter, toasted pecan nuts, and confectioner's sugar. Stir until well combined.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until a dough forms. Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.

On a lightly floured surface, roll out the chilled dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch. Transfer the dough to the preheated tava-griddle and spread the pecan mixture evenly over the center, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the dough over the filling, pressing the dough gently to seal. Brush the egg wash over the crust and sprinkle with yellow food coloring.
Bake the galette for 25-30 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is bubbly.
Remove the galette from the tava-griddle and let cool for 10 minutes before serving. Dust with confectioner's sugar before slicing.
Optional: Top with whipped cream or a scoop of vanilla ice cream for an extra-special treat.
